meta.description: Cron-driven video generation: pick a Folder A video reference → build prompt with motion → route via cost-aware router → MiniMax H3 cloud primary → post-process → Telegram approval. Runs daily at 13:00 SAST.
importNotes: Set MINIMAX_API_TOKEN, FAL_API_KEY, TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN, TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID in .env before activating
MiniMax H3 is the primary path. Hero tier (Kling) only fires when explicitly flagged.
Cost cap defaults to $30/mo. Adjust via MONTHLY_COST_CAP_USD in .env.
Test with the Run Once button before activating the schedule
